## Capability Design Summary — Piper (`piper`)

**5 reusable, package-bound, task-neutral capabilities** covering all 18 catalog tasks:

| # | `capability_id` | `method_name` | Single Effect | Key Tasks |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `move_end_effector` | `move_end_effector(request)` | Move ee_site to a world-frame 3-D position | `mw_reach_target`, approach phases of all contact tasks |
| 2 | `set_gripper_aperture` | `set_gripper_aperture(request)` | Set joint7 slide position [0, 0.035 m] | `mw_pick_place`, `mw_pick_place_wall`, `mw_bin_picking`, `mw_pick_out_of_hole`, `mw_peg_insertion_side` |
| 3 | `move_end_effector_with_wrist` | `move_end_effector_with_wrist(request)` | Move ee_site + command joint6 wrist-roll | `mw_pick_place`, `mw_pick_place_wall`, `mw_bin_picking`, `mw_pick_out_of_hole`, `mw_peg_insertion_side` |
| 4 | `apply_contact_displacement` | `apply_contact_displacement(request)` | EE moves from contact_xyz to terminal_xyz under contact | All push/press/pull/sweep/drawer/button/handle/door/faucet/dial/lever tasks |
| 5 | `move_end_effector_via_waypoint` | `move_end_effector_via_waypoint(request)` | EE visits waypoint_xyz then reaches final_xyz (ordered) | `mw_pick_place_wall`, `mw_push_wall`, `mw_door_open/close`, `mw_faucet_open`, `mw_dial_turn`, `mw_lever_pull`, `mw_bin_picking`, `mw_pick_out_of_hole`, `mw_peg_insertion_side` |

**Design decisions:**
- No capability names a task object, fixture, handle, or private site — all inputs are robot-frame positions/scalars.
- Criteria thresholds are sourced directly from catalog `source_refs` (0.05 m reach, 0.05 m push, 0.05 m pick-place EE) or marked **proposed** (0.003 m gripper settling) with explicit notes.
- `task_support` covers every task × capability pair with rationale; no ordered calls or macros are included.
- No skeleton method names are shadowed (`move_cartesian`, `set_gripper_control`, etc. are all distinct from the capability `method_name` values).
